query:
SELECT a.id, DATE(a.startTime) as appointmentDate, TIME(a.startTime) as appointmentTime, a.status, p.name as patientName
FROM appointments a
LEFT JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
WHERE a.seriesId = 'series-1781709663437-6ahe6c'
ORDER BY a.startTime;
